facts.business: Incredible Industries Limited manufactures steel products including billets, bars, wire rods, and nails.
facts.related_party_note: The Company is required to enter into various contracts or arrangements with Adhunik Corporation Limited, its Related Party, for a period commencing from the conclusion of the 47th Annual General Meeting up to the 48th Annual General Meeting, estimated at Rs. 800 crore, at arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business.
